steps.name: gate:prereqs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
missing=0
for tool in git cargo; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL missing prerequisite: $tool"; missing=1; }
done
[ -f Cargo.lock ] || { echo "FAIL missing prerequisite: Cargo.lock (offline workspace test)"; missing=1; }
exit "$missing"

steps.name: gate:freshness
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
base="${FAB_BASE_REF:-origin/main}"
git fetch --quiet --depth 50 origin "${base#origin/}" || { echo "FAIL missing prerequisite: cannot fetch $base"; exit 127; }
head_ref="${FAB_GIT_REF:-$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)}"
case "$head_ref" in main|refs/heads/main) echo "freshness: base branch run"; exit 0;; esac
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" HEAD; then
  echo "remote: stale — $base has moved; rebase before this run can be CI evidence"
  exit 1
fi
echo "freshness: $base is an ancestor of $head_ref"
